description: A review in a language with no compiler to lean on, so the reviewer has to reason about the code. Pins that code_review is not Go-specific.
title: Review slugify
prompt: Review slug.js and slug.test.js. This function builds URL path segments from user-supplied titles. Judge correctness, the cases the tests miss, and anything a caller could be surprised by. Report only findings you can point at a line for.
